COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 25, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM

Samantha Mehlinger, Chair  Helena Donato-Sapp, Commissioner
Irma Archuleta, Vice Chair  Maria Gonzalez, Commissioner
Jennifer Allen Harper, Commissioner  Alyce LaViolette, Commissioner
Dr. Stephanie Anckle, Commissioner  Vanessa Mosqueda, Commissioner

  COMMISSION FOR WOMEN AND GIRLS IN-PERSON MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO ALANAH.GRANT@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 948 8011 6533
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/94880116533

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55673  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Commission for Women and
  Girls meeting of Wednesday, May 28, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55674  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Office of Equity on the
  Long Beach Values Act and Justice Fund.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55675  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from “ORALE” (Organizing
  Rooted in Abolition, Liberation, and Empowerment) regarding the impacts of
  immigration enforcement activity on Long Beach women and girls.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55676  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Commission for Women and Girls
  2024-2025 Annual Report.

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55677  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the City Attorney on Long
  Beach Commission attendance policies.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55679  Recommendation to discuss and approve the transmittal of a letter to the Mayor
  and City Council regarding the timely investment in gender-equitable facilities at the
  Long Beach Fire Regional Training Center during the current financial planning
  period.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-55680  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Commission for Women and Girls on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamela Austin, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact he Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

A motion was made by Commissioner LaViolette, to elect Chair Mehlinger for Chair of the
Commission for Women and Girls. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  8  Allen Harper, Anckle, Donato-Sapp, Gonzalez, LaViolette, Mosqueda, Archuleta,
  Mehlinger
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  0  None

A motion was made by Commissioner LaViolette, to elect Vice Chair Archuleta for Vice Chair
of the Commission for Women and Girls. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  8  Allen Harper, Anckle, Donato-Sapp, Gonzalez, LaViolette, Mosqueda, Archuleta,
  Mehlinger
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  0  None

Chair Mehlinger declared the nominations open for Chair.

Commissioner LaViolette nominated Chair Mehlinger for Chair of the Commission for Women and
Girls.

There being no further nominations, Chair Mehlinger declared the nominations closed for Chair.

Chair Mehlinger accepted the Chair of the Commission for Women and Girls nomination.

Chair Mehlinger declared the nominations open for Vice Chair.

Commissioner LaViolette nominated Vice Chair Archuleta for Vice Chair of the Commission for
Women and Girls.
